brick_layers_enabled.label: Brick Layers
brick_layers_enabled.description: Shift alternating inner wall perimeter loops up by half a layer height, creating interlocking brick-like walls. This dramatically improves vertical part strength by preventing aligned layer seams. Requires at least 2 inner wall lines. The innermost wall (adjacent to infill) is always kept at nominal height. Recommended: disable 'Alternate Extra Wall', increase 'Z Hop Height' by half the layer height, and set combing to 'Not in Skin' or 'Off'.

brick_layers_extrusion_multiplier.label: Brick Layers Extrusion Multiplier
brick_layers_extrusion_multiplier.description: Multiplier for extrusion on shifted wall loops. Compensates for the increased gap between the shifted loop and the layer below. Values around 1.05 work well.

brick_layers_start_layer.label: Brick Layers Start Layer
brick_layers_start_layer.description: First layer to apply brick pattern (layer number starting at 1). Layers before this are printed normally. Recommended to skip at least 2-3 layers for bed adhesion.

brick_layers_end_layer.label: Brick Layers End Layer
brick_layers_end_layer.description: Last layer to apply brick pattern. Use -1 (or 0) to apply to all layers. Python-style negative indexing is supported: -3 means 'apply until 3 layers from the top' (top 3 layers printed normally), -5 leaves the top 5 layers plain, etc. The plugin derives the effective last layer from (machine_height / layer_height), so this counts from the printer's maximum build height rather than each model's individual top layer.

brick_layers_apply_inner_walls.label: Brick Layers Inner Walls
brick_layers_apply_inner_walls.description: Shift alternating inner wall perimeter loops. This is the primary use case for brick layers.

brick_layers_apply_outer_walls.label: Brick Layers Outer Walls
brick_layers_apply_outer_walls.description: Shift alternating outer wall perimeter loops. Warning: this affects dimensional accuracy and surface finish. Only enable if you need maximum strength.

brick_layers_contour_break_distance.label: Brick Layers Contour Break Distance
brick_layers_contour_break_distance.description: Maximum XY distance between consecutive wall segments that the plugin still considers to be part of the same contour. When the nozzle would need to move further than this between two inner-wall paths, they are treated as belonging to different spatial contours, the brick pattern counter is reset for each contour, and each contour's local innermost wall is protected. Lower values split groups more aggressively (safer for complex wall-only geometries); higher values keep more walls in one group (fewer Z-hops, more likely to miss protection on complex shapes). An automatic safety cap of 3× line width is always applied, so a mis-configured high value cannot silently merge neighbouring contours.
